articles.title: This made my day: Migrant workers and passers-by move fallen tree off road
articles.content: When a tree fell onto the road during Friday (Sept 18) evening peak-hour, a group of people sprung into action. More than 10 migrant workers and passers-by helped to move the fallen tree off the road. The incident happened at the intersection between MacPherson Road and Jalan Wangi at around 6pm, Lianhe Zaobao reported. The road was cleared in about five minutes. Others removed branches off the road. "So much community spirit, all because they don’t want a roadblock," she wrote. Her social media post has garnered over 5,000 'likes', with netizens commending everyone involved for their teamwork and kampung spirit.
